How-to guide

Use your own word lists

Goal

Add a word list of your own, check how the app reads it before you commit to it, and choose it in Search and Autofill. Use this when the shipped list lacks words you want, such as names or topic vocabulary.

Prerequisites

  • The app is running (Install on macOS), started from the project folder.
  • A plain text file with your words.

Steps

1. Prepare the file

Put one entry per line. Each line can be a bare word, a word with a score after a semicolon, or a word with a score after a comma:

# my list (blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored)
ZEBRA;80
quiz,60
CAFÉ

The full rules (letters A-Z only, accents folded, 3 to 21 letters, scores, duplicates) are in File formats. The upload preview tells you how many lines were skipped and why, so you can fix the file before you confirm.

2. Upload it in the app

  1. Open the Lists tool in the left rail.
  2. Click Upload Wordlist.
  3. Type a name in Wordlist Name: and choose the file with Select File:.
  4. Click Upload. Nothing is stored yet: the app shows a Preview with the number of valid words, the number skipped with the reason for each kind, and the first words with their scores.
  5. Click Confirm to store the list, or Cancel to throw the preview away.

If the preview finds no valid words, the app refuses the upload and reports why.

The list is stored as a text file under data/wordlists/custom/ in the project folder. unverified Uploading under the name of an existing custom list appears from the code to add the new words to that list rather than replace it, and the list's displayed name may be the name you typed with underscores shown as spaces; neither was run for this page.

3. Use it

  • Autofill: tick it under Custom in the Word Lists section. A ticked custom list shows a Priority theme list choice; select it and the fill prefers words from that list (Autofill a grid). Note that Verify words and Clean grid check only the shipped Comprehensive Dictionary, so words that exist only in your list are flagged as invalid (Check and clean a grid).

4. Change or remove a custom list

Select the list in the Lists tool. Add Words opens a box (Enter words (one per line)) that you submit with Add Words to List, and Show Stats shows its size and letter statistics. The delete button asks, in a browser dialog, Delete wordlist "custom/<name>"? This cannot be undone.

The shipped lists are read-only. The app refuses to overwrite or delete them and tells you to create a custom list instead.

Final Result

Your list appears in Search and in Autofill's Word Lists, and a search for a pattern that your words fit returns them with your list's file name shown as the source.
